title: University Sign-In
subtitle: AdviseCare is accessed through your university identity provider. Local passwords are not held by this system.
ssoHint: You will be redirected to the institutional identity provider and returned here once authenticated.
demoHint: This build ships without a live identity provider. Choose a role to enter the corresponding workspace.
roleStudentCaption: Personal record, consent matrix, access history
noticeBody: Authentication events, role assumption and every subsequent read are written to the access ledger. Records cannot be edited or deleted once committed.
legalLine: Governed by Vietnam Personal Data Protection Decree (PDPD 13/2023) and the institutional data charter.
